action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with moderate seasonality and an unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.267). The leader (mean over the 9 most consistently-ranked models) sits within 0.01 of three other subset-mean/median strategies, and the full-pool mean and fitted-weight approaches are far worse, confirming that the weak tail of the pool (worst error 560) is the main risk.
